# The University of Virginia

> The University of Virginia is a public research university offering undergraduate, graduate, and professional education, research, healthcare, and campus life resources.

UVA’s web presence spans institutional information, academics, admissions-related student resources, research initiatives, news, events, and operational services for students, faculty, staff, and visitors.

## Main University

- [The University of Virginia](https://www.virginia.edu/): University homepage with academics, research, student life, news, and institutional highlights.
- [About UVA](https://www.virginia.edu/about-uva/): Overview of the university’s history, leadership, mission, and defining characteristics.
- [Facts and Figures](https://www.virginia.edu/facts-figures/): Institutional statistics on enrollment, faculty, finances, and university profile data.
- [Mission](https://www.virginia.edu/mission/): UVA mission statement and core institutional purpose.
- [Contact Us](https://www.virginia.edu/contact-us/): Central university contact information and communication channels.
- [Consumer Information](https://www.virginia.edu/consumer-information/): Required disclosures and consumer information for students and families.
- [Copyright](https://www.virginia.edu/copyright/): Copyright and intellectual property information for university web content.

## Academics

- [Academics](https://www.virginia.edu/academics/): Central academic overview covering schools, programs, and learning opportunities.
- [Schools](https://www.virginia.edu/academics/#schools/): Jump link to UVA’s schools and academic units.
- [Majors and Minors](https://www.virginia.edu/majors-minors/): Directory of undergraduate majors and minors offered across the university.
- [Undergraduate Studies](https://www.virginia.edu/undergraduate-studies/): Information on undergraduate education, curriculum, and academic experience.
- [Graduate Studies](https://www.virginia.edu/graduate-studies/): Overview of graduate and professional study opportunities at UVA.
- [Academic Calendar](https://registrar.virginia.edu/calendar/academic): Official academic calendar with term dates, deadlines, and breaks.
- [Online Learning](https://online.virginia.edu/): Online and digital learning programs, courses, and educational offerings.

## Student Life and Campus Experience

- [Life at UVA](https://www.virginia.edu/life-uva/): Student life, traditions, housing, organizations, and campus culture overview.
- [Visit UVA](https://www.virginia.edu/visit-uva/): Visitor information, campus tours, and planning resources for prospective visitors.
- [Directory](https://search.people.virginia.edu/): University people directory for finding faculty, staff, and students.
- [Email](https://in.virginia.edu/email): Access and support information for university email services.
- [UVACanvas](https://canvas.virginia.edu/): Learning management system for courses, assignments, and instructional materials.
- [SIS](https://sisuva.admin.virginia.edu/ihprd/signon.html): Student Information System for enrollment, records, and academic administration.

## Research and Innovation

- [Research](https://www.virginia.edu/research/): University research overview, discoveries, and institutional research priorities.
- [Research Focus Areas](https://www.virginia.edu/research/#research-focus-areas): Key interdisciplinary areas where UVA concentrates research efforts.
- [Pan-University Institutes](https://www.virginia.edu/research/#pan-university-institutes): Institutes that connect researchers across schools and disciplines.
- [Discovery and Innovation](https://www.virginia.edu/): Homepage section highlighting research breakthroughs and innovation stories.

## News and Events

- [UVA Today](https://news.virginia.edu/): Official university news source covering research, academics, and campus developments.
- [Events](https://www.virginia.edu/): Homepage events section featuring upcoming university happenings and programs.
- [Office of the President](https://president.virginia.edu/): Messages, priorities, speeches, and updates from the university president.

## Strategy, Leadership, and Advancement

- [UVA’s 2030 Strategic Plan](https://strategicplan.virginia.edu/): Long-term institutional strategy, goals, and implementation priorities.
- [Office of the President](https://president.virginia.edu/): Presidential leadership, university priorities, and official communications.
- [Giving](https://giving.virginia.edu/): Philanthropy, fundraising priorities, and ways to support UVA.
- [Jobs](https://hr.virginia.edu/careers-uva/job-openings): Faculty and staff employment opportunities across the university.

## Safety, Access, and Policy

- [Accessibility](https://accessibility.virginia.edu/): Digital and campus accessibility resources, standards, and support.
- [Emergency](https://uvaemergency.virginia.edu/): Emergency alerts, preparedness information, and safety resources.
- [FOIA](https://universitycounsel.virginia.edu/foia): Freedom of Information Act guidance and request information.
- [Non-Discrimination Notice](https://eocr.virginia.edu/notice-non-discrimination-and-equal-opportunity): Equal opportunity and non-discrimination policy notice.
- [Privacy](https://privacy.virginia.edu/): University privacy policies, notices, and data handling information.
- [Tuition Notice](https://bov.virginia.edu/sites/g/files/jsddwu1171/files/2026-03/Public%20Comment%20Session.pdf): Board of Visitors public comment notice related to tuition matters.
